description: Machine-readable live work queue. Passing entries are retained for 24 hours, then removed by pnpm features:prune; durable behavior and evidence remain in product specs and Git/PR history. See docs/FEATURES.md for rules.

features.behavior: MongoDB connection UX and safety fixes found in live Atlas QA: recent-connection cards truncate instead of overflowing the Switch-database drawer; the fields-mode form composes and round-trips mongodb+srv:// targets (no port) via a new SRV toggle; the drawer's per-server "Databases on this server" list is hidden for MongoDB since the sidebar explorer already lists every accessible database; a MongoDB role lacking cluster-wide listDatabases falls back to introspecting just the URL-scoped database instead of throwing; GET /api/overview and GET /api/databases normalize an engine permission denial into the shared safe 403 body instead of leaking raw driver text; the sidebar's "Schemas unavailable" error is vertically centered in the panel instead of top-anchored; and the Settings screen's Access category is removed for now.
features.verification: pnpm --filter @qyre/ui test && pnpm --filter @qyre/mongodb test && pnpm --filter @qyre/server test && pnpm --filter @qyre/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui build && pnpm --filter @qyre/web build && pnpm verify:pr
features.evidence: Local unit suites pass: @qyre/mongodb 81/81, @qyre/ui 445/445, @qyre/server 310/310. Typecheck and build pass for core/mongodb/server/ui/web. Manually verified in the qyre-preview-mongo browser preview: long recent-connection entries truncate with a hover title; the MongoDB fields-mode SRV checkbox disables Port and composes/reconnects a mongodb+srv:// URL; the Switch-database drawer no longer shows "Databases on this server" for MongoDB; a forced /api/overview failure renders the sidebar error centered in the panel (not top-anchored); Settings shows only Connection/Appearance/Data & history, no Access category.

features.behavior: Fix Tables QA regressions in shared UI behavior: inline scalar Enter/Tab staging and filter keyboard actions use the live input value instead of render-lagged React state; the filter composer remains fully operable by Arrow keys, Enter, and Escape; and declared SQLite BOOLEAN cells render true/false labels while preserving MySQL TINYINT(1) as numeric 0/1. Preserve existing mutation validation, filter semantics, and cross-engine write behavior.
features.verification: pnpm --filter @qyre/ui test && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui build && pnpm --filter @qyre/web build && node scripts/with-local-env.mjs pnpm exec playwright test e2e/row-editing-commit.spec.ts e2e/connect-and-inspect.spec.ts --project=postgres && pnpm verify:pr
features.evidence: Merged PR #161 (https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/161) as 2acd2f6. Claude Tables UX smoke QA reproduced immediate Enter staging failures on PostgreSQL and MySQL, keyboard-only filter composition failures, a top-level Escape focus failure, and SQLite declared-BOOLEAN display as raw 0/1. Inline Enter/Tab and filter keyboard actions now read live input values; the column step restores search focus; and declared SQLite BOOLEAN display maps 0/1 to false/true while MySQL TINYINT(1) and raw copy/export data remain numeric. UI tests pass 426/426; UI typecheck/build and five focused PostgreSQL browser journeys pass. The Node 22 local and pre-push `pnpm verify:pr` gates pass with 34/34 package tasks, smoke E2E (11 passed, 4 skipped), and full E2E (32 passed, 55 skipped) across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB.

features.behavior: DataGrip-style grid editing across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB: single-click whole-cell selection; double-click/Enter/F2 inline editing for scalar values; shared Add row, Duplicate row, staged delete, JSON operation/SQL statement preview, and Commit bar; BSON-preserving MongoDB field updates with stable hexadecimal ObjectId row keys, optimistic conflict guards, and validated regex, timestamp, code, MinKey, and MaxKey JSON editors; shared True/False boolean and enum selectors; lossless date, time, time-with-time-zone, timestamp, and PostgreSQL interval editing; automatic dismissal of any active scalar, structured, or inserted-row editor when another body cell is clicked; compact right-side drawer editing for JSON, supported arrays, binary hex, XML, and intervals, with visible Format/Minify/Copy and fixed actions; grouped binary hex with byte count and ASCII preview under a friendly bytes label; binary values normalized to hex when duplicating rows; plain-text JSON/array substring filters on SQL engines and native structured containment on MongoDB; validated PostgreSQL bit-string and network editing; anchored SET editing with optional full-panel expansion; spreadsheet keyboard navigation, typed copy/paste, nullable clearing, undo, staged dirty-state feedback, and page-level commit; automatic catalog/row refresh after successful writes; fixed-width truncated columns; adaptive icon-only shell tabs and row actions below the desktop breakpoint; and a non-executing SQL Explain action with no Analyze control.
features.verification: pnpm --filter @qyre/ui test && pnpm --filter @qyre/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @qyre/ui build && pnpm --filter @qyre/web build && pnpm --filter @qyre/qyre build && pnpm verify:pr
features.evidence: Merged PR #160 (https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/160) as ed44633 after rounds 8-16 were pushed through b06a89d. Rounds 3-16 live-review refinements include true whole-cell selection/editing, stable long-text geometry, shared typed scalar/structured/binary editors, lossless temporal and interval handling, SQL substring filters, immediate post-write refresh, and MongoDB's replacement of the separate whole-document drawer with the same Add/Duplicate/edit/delete/Commit grid used by SQL. MongoDB operations preview JSON, update changed fields through `$set`, preserve existing BSON types, reject same-field concurrent edits using original-value guards, and author regex, timestamp, code, MinKey, and MaxKey through validated JSON drawers with Add-row templates. Round 14 normalizes ObjectIds to stable lowercase hex across BSON package instances and safely accepts the `$oid` wire form. Round 15 additionally accepts only the exact legacy 12-byte buffer payload retained by an already-open pre-fix browser page. Round 16 commits the live input value on blur so fast click-away cannot drop the final scalar edit. Rebuilt production browser checks pass in MongoDB and PostgreSQL; server tests pass 309/309 and UI tests pass 421/421. The Node 22 local and pre-push `pnpm verify:pr` gates pass with 34/34 package tasks, check:state, smoke E2E (11 passed, 4 skipped), and full E2E (30 passed, 47 skipped) across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB. Hosted jobs could not run because GitHub Actions credits were exhausted.
